QingHong supports almost all Adblock Plus filter rules.

Block all requests to example.com:
||example.com^ (or example.com)

Wildcards are supported, e.g.:
||example.com/js/ads_*.js

Allow specific requests (whitelist), e.g.:
@@||example.com^

Hide page elements with rules like:
example.com###ad
